purpose: Record explicit user approval of Bella's five MXF Clip Name owner, text, availability and retention rules.
status: Approved requirements; no Bella runtime implementation, cutover or Bin Filter change.

authorization.source: Direct human approval in the current conversation
authorization.statement: OK, let's lock those Clip Name rules in for Bella. Next, how do Media Composer and MDVX read Project from MXF, and what should Bella read and keep?
authorization.scope: Approves the five previously proposed Clip Name rules in the focused MXF review. The request to review Project does not approve new Project rules or other MXF field/navigation proposals.

agreedBellaRules.owner: Read GenericPackage.Name from the exact MaterialPackage already selected by the approved MXF identity rules. Read the name after selecting the master; an empty name does not authorize a different master.
agreedBellaRules.textAndBoundary: Decode the bounded value as UTF-16BE into owned QString with small checked C++17/Qt 6.5.3 helpers and QtEndian. Preserve characters, spelling, case, punctuation and whitespace. Validate complete code units and surrogate pairs. Stop at the first U+0000 terminator if present; accept otherwise complete valid text ending at the declared boundary without a terminator.
agreedBellaRules.noGuessedRecovery: Do not retry UTF-8 or MacRoman, invent a legacy counterpart, apply lossy replacement or trim the name. Odd byte counts and malformed text leave it unreadable. Contradictory Name values do not establish a usable name.
agreedBellaRules.availability: Missing, empty or unreadable Name, or no uniquely selected master, supplies no MXF Clip Name. Keep the physical file and independently valid IDs/technical facts. On the database-unavailable MXF fallback, show the Clip Name cell blank instead of Filename, file-source Name or a track name.
agreedBellaRules.retention: Retain one selected owned QString and only necessary availability state. Release raw name bytes, temporary references and header storage. Keep no second legacy string, name-comparison graph or separate per-row formatting string. Reuse the same selected master for its other fields.

unchanged: The preceding MXF FileMobId/MasterMobId requirements remain approved.
The database-unavailable MXF Duration fallback and blank Original Bin rule remain authoritative.
OldScanner stays active until explicit cutover approval; Bin Filter remains outside this work.
remaining: MXF Project is the next focused review and its new rules remain unapproved.
MDB-versus-MXF Clip Name priority remains part of the deferred source-priority discussion.
This approval creates no new header-opening reason or scan of other physical headers to obtain a different name.
Other MXF field/navigation choices, abnormal layouts, third-party coverage, malformed fixtures and fresh implementation verification remain separate work.
supersedes: The proposed/not-yet-approved status of the five Clip Name rules in the 22 October focused review and research receipt. Historical native, MDVx, current-source and ten-header observations and their limitations remain unchanged.
